content:
Rumors about the new Apple TV 4K have long pointed to a more modern chip to support Apple Intelligence. However, according to a new leak discovered by Aaron Perris, the chip in the new device will be even more powerful than expected.

According to code leaks, an Apple TV 4K is on the way, featuring an A19 or A19 Pro chip

We've been waiting for the new Apple TV 4K for quite a long time — longer than any previous update cycle in the product's history.

Originally, there were rumors that the new model would launch in 2025, with evidence at the time suggesting it would come equipped with an A17 Pro chip. That's the minimum spec currently required to support Apple Intelligence, so it made perfect sense and would be a significant upgrade over the existing A15 Bionic.

However, according to Aaron Perris, the new Apple TV 4K will feature a more powerful chip than expected. He wrote:

We've discovered references to an upcoming Apple TV model, AppleTV18,1, meaning it will feature an A19 or A19 Pro chip

top rated comment from razmsu

All I want is for the remote to make a sound when I'm looking for it, please.

The "18,1" designation matches the identifier scheme Apple used last year for the iPhone 17 lineup. Some iPhone 17 models feature the A19 chip, while the iPhone Air and 17 Pro models use the A19 Pro.

Either chip would be a substantial upgrade for the Apple TV. But the A19 Pro seems more likely, as it's the only one that could exclusively support the most advanced Siri AI features.

Siri AI is expected to be one of the headline features of the new Apple TV 4K. Given how long the hardware refresh has been, hopefully Apple doesn't miss out on certain AI features right out of the gate.

Planning to buy the new Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
